name: Jeb Bradley
summary: Joseph Edmund "Jeb" Bradley III (born October 20, 1952) is an American politician and member of the Republican Party who served in New Hampshire’s State Senate from 2009 to 2024. He was a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 1990 to 2002, and then served as the U.S. representative for New Hampshire's 1st congressional district from 2003 to 2007. He was the Majority Leader of the New Hampshire Senate from 2010 to 2018 and again from 2020 to 2022.
